title: Refuse PR admission when the canonical series record is missing
body:
Advisory from the PR #135 review panels (standards round 2, spec third panel): scripts/pr-preflight.mjs:425 binds a discovered exact-head record to its reservation but not to its canonical series path, so a byte-identical copy at the legacy .krn/runs/review/<head>/record.json can stand in when the canonical records/<ordinal>.json was deleted.
Acceptance: PR admission refuses when the reserved ordinal's canonical record is missing, even if an identical copy exists elsewhere; a frozen observer fails on the base by assertion and passes on the head. Keep the public report shape for the GLOBAL receiver.
